Theme

Latin word

bellum

bellum, bellī n.

noun, second declension

war

In this lexicon

  • war

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 1.22.4: bellum indīcī posse (Lewis & Short); Traupman 183, 403, 404, 393; Traupman 188, 189

  • bellum īnferre (+ dat.): attack

    classical

  • Quī dēsīderat pācem praeparet bellum.: if you want peace, prepare for war

    late Latin

Examples

  • In amōre haec omnia īnsunt vitia: injūriae, suspīciōnēs, inimīcitiae, indūtiae, bellum, pāx rūrsum.

    Love has all these troubles in it: wrongs, suspicions, quarrels, truces, war, then peace again.Ter. Eun. 59–61

    In the entry for war

  • Diū adparandum est bellum, ut vincās celerius.

    Prepare long for a war, so that you win it sooner.Publil. Syr. D 3
